claim_tested: ANXA2R is a type I plasma-membrane receptor for annexin A2
key_finding: 125I-annexin II binding to PSV10 stromal cells: single class of sites, Kd 5.79 nM, Bmax 2.13e5/cell; expression cloning from a human marrow cDNA library in NIH3T3 identified a clone encoding a '26-kDa type I membrane receptor protein' in HEK293; anti-receptor antibody blocked annexin II-induced osteoclast formation
context: Human marrow stromal cells (PSV10), NIH3T3 and HEK293 transfectants
confidence_limitations: Single study, never independently replicated; topology asserted, not mapped (no protease protection, no surface biotinylation, no N-glycosylation mapping); cross-linked species reacted with anti-p11 (S100A10), not anti-p36

claim_tested: ANXA2R has a signal peptide and a transmembrane helix
key_finding: No signal peptide (max KD w=7 over res 1-30 = 0.89; 5 Pro in res 18-30); no TM window (max KD19 = 1.54; best 19-aa dG(app) = +3.68 kcal/mol vs -3.84 to +1.22 for six membrane-anchored controls); no N-myristoylation (res 2 = Glu); no CaaX; no GPI signal
confidence_limitations: Prediction only; benchmarked internally against positive and negative controls computed identically

claim_tested: ANXA2R folds into a ligand-binding ectodomain
key_finding: Mean pLDDT 55.7, 0% of residues >90, 88% <70; mean PAE 25.97 A; Rg(CA) 38.3 A vs 16.3 A expected for a folded 193-aa globule and 42.6 A for a random coil; single helix-basin segment at res 162-187, rest coil/extended
confidence_limitations: Model, not experiment; low pLDDT is itself the evidence of disorder

citation: This work (Foldseek 3Di-AA vs afdb50 / afdb-swissprot / pdb100)
claim_tested: ANXA2R has structural relatives that would hint at receptor function
key_finding: 0 hits in afdb50 and pdb100; only the self-hit in afdb-swissprot (E=7.5e-31, 100% id). No structural relative anywhere in the PDB or clustered AFDB
confidence_limitations: A disordered query returns few Foldseek hits by construction, so this is consistent with but not independent of the disorder result

claim_tested: the putative membrane anchor is conserved
key_finding: Orthologues in 18 eutherian species only, none in mouse, rat, dog or any non-mammal; 40-52% identity outside primates; in non-primate orthologues the hydrophobic segment 165-190 has mean identity 0.356 and the extreme C-terminus 0.286, versus 0.363 for the disordered linker 78-148
context: Ensembl release orthology, 37 pairwise protein alignments
confidence_limitations: Compara ortholog calls for fast-evolving short ORFs can be incomplete; absence in mouse may be a calling failure rather than true absence

key_finding: All 8 IntAct records for Q3ZCQ2 come from this ISG interactome: ANXA2R pulls down the cytoplasmic CCR4-NOT deadenylase complex (CNOT1 score 0.54, CNOT3, CNOT7, CNOT9, CNOT6L) and TNKS1BP1; CNOT1 association is additionally supported by confocal microscopy
context: Human cells, GFP/affinity-purification MS plus confocal imaging
confidence_limitations: Affinity purification of a tagged bait; CCR4-NOT is a frequent AP-MS background, so the interaction itself is low-confidence, but the assay context is intracellular

claim_tested: ANXA2R is at the plasma membrane
key_finding: HPA protein class 'Predicted intracellular proteins'; immunofluorescence subcellular location Nucleoplasm (main), Cytosol, Cytoplasmic bodies, reliability 'Approved'; no plasma-membrane location; secretome location: none
context: Human cell lines, immunofluorescence with a single antibody
confidence_limitations: Single-antibody IF, no independent antibody validation; database-level evidence

claim_tested: the 2006 type I topology claim is unreliable
key_finding: 'PubMed:16895901 reports that it is a type I membrane protein. However, no clear transmembrane region is detected by prediction methods, suggesting that its localization at the plasma membrane is unsure'
confidence_limitations: Curator inference, consistent with this analysis

citation: InterPro IPR031449 / Pfam PF15721 / PANTHER PTHR38820
claim_tested: GO:0038023 signaling receptor activity is independently supported
key_finding: The only GO MF besides protein binding is GO:0038023 (IEA, GO_REF:0000002) inherited from InterPro IPR031449, an ANXA2R-only family whose name derives from PMID:16895901. No sequence or structural feature underlies the term
confidence_limitations: Circular carry-over of the 2006 claim into an automatic annotation
